Client compatibility: Unadorned httpx.Client (Linux Chrome UA, no session cookies/headers) succeeds on current requests
Pacing tolerance: HostLimiter 1.5s interval is accepted without rate limits or IP bans
Single-worker pilot success: 20/20 acquisitions succeeded in primary valid windows, 10/10 in supplemental run

Target group companies had 0 downloaded documents for the sampled FYs in the historical dataset
unknown_not_established: Root cause of historical 2026-09-11 acquisition losses
Whether historical losses were caused by origin outage, WAF blocking, rate limiting, CDN failure, or network disruption
Whether origin applies time-of-day or market-hours restrictions
How origin behaves under multi-worker high concurrency or full 576-observation workload

basis: Direct evidence: Baseline R1 acquisition succeeded completely (20/20 in valid windows) on the pilot sample without modifications.
Absence of failure signal: The historical failure mode was NOT reproduced under current test conditions; there is no active failure trace to repair.
Historical cause unknown: Without knowing what failed historically, designing an acquisition intervention would be unguided speculation.
Experimental limitations: The three-window temporal protocol was interrupted (only 2 windows valid), and concurrency/scale remain untested.
Scope caveat: This decision does NOT mean the acquisition problem is solved; it means P-R1X evidence alone cannot justify or guide a specific repair.

unresolved_confounders: Time-of-day / market-hours origin policy: Valid windows ran in off-market hours (20:05 and 21:35 UTC); daytime/market-hours behavior was not tested in scheduled windows.
Concurrency and connection load: Single sequential worker does not test multi-worker concurrency or origin connection pooling pressure.
IP and client network environment: Current host network environment and IP address may differ from historical acquisition environment.
Origin content volatility: Current availability of historical archives does not guarantee identical origin infrastructure or CDN policies as 2026-09-11.
methodological_limitations: Sample size: N=10 observations (census of pilot sample, small subset of 576-observation universe).
Temporal interruption: Nominal Window 3 suffered process suspension / host sleep, truncating scheduled temporal coverage to 2 windows (90-minute delta).
No failure reproduction: Diagnostic pilot tested baseline behavior only; failure conditions remain unobserved.
